checks_no_invocation: The plan has no {adapter} invocation for the instance {tool}.
checks_cancelled: The run was cancelled; {tool} was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
checks_timeout: {tool} exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended; nothing was proven.
checks_services_not_configured: jgates.yml has no services section: set up the project's compose services (the compose files and the target) and the check runs on them.
checks_setting_target: The target of the instance {tool} is {value}; use service:<name>:<port>[/path] (a compose service) or an http or https URL.
checks_exit_mismatch: {tool} ended with code {code}, which its report does not explain ({failed, plural, one {# failing test} other {# failing tests}}): the result is not trusted. {detail}
e2e_setting_runner: The e2eRunner of the instance {tool} is {value}; use one of: {allowed}.
e2e_no_runner: The component {dir} has no Playwright Test configuration or dependency (@playwright/test) and does not declare pytest-playwright. Set e2eRunner on the instance or add the runner to the project.
e2e_missing: The e2e runner {runner} is not a dependency of the project ({detail}). Add it to the component's dependencies; the run installs them into its own volume and never into your folder.
e2e_condition_executes: Runs the project's e2e tests (project code) against its compose services, with Chromium from the toolchain volume.
e2e_condition_target: The application under test: {url} (BASE_URL for Playwright Test, --base-url for pytest-playwright).
e2e_condition_no_target: No target: the tests use the URLs of their own configuration (set services.target or tools.<id>.target to hand one over).
e2e_limitation: The tests execute and drive the project's services: the result is self-reported and never cached; Chromium only.
e2e_metric_flaky: E2e tests passed on a retry (flaky)
e2e_no_tests: {tool} found no e2e test to run: nothing was proven.
e2e_finding_error: An error outside the e2e tests: {message}
e2e_reason: {tool} {version} against {target}: {executed, plural, one {# test} other {# tests}} executed, {failed} failed, {flaky} flaky, {skipped} skipped
migration_setting_framework: The framework of the instance {tool} is {value}; use one of: {allowed}.
migration_setting_env: The databaseUrlEnv of the instance {tool} is {value}; use an environment variable name (letters, digits and _).
migration_setting_url: The databaseUrl of the instance {tool} must be a non-empty URL of the services database.
migration_no_framework: The component {dir} has no migrations JGates can check (alembic.ini, a Django manage.py, prisma/schema.prisma with prisma, or an EF Core project with Migrations/*ModelSnapshot.cs). Set framework on the instance.
migration_missing: {framework} is not available to the check ({detail}). Declare it in the component's dependencies (dotnet-ef comes from the tools image).
migration_condition: Asks {framework} whether the models and the migrations agree, with the project's own configuration (project code loads).
migration_condition_url: The services database is handed over in {variable}.
migration_limitation: The framework loads the project's settings and models: the result is self-reported and never cached; Alembic upgrades the run's own services database to head first.
migration_prepare_failed: {framework} could not prepare the database before the comparison (code {code}): {detail}
migration_unexplained: {framework} ended with code {code} and an output that says neither drift nor no drift: the result is not trusted. {detail}
migration_reason_clean: {framework} {version}: the models and the migrations agree
migration_reason_drift: {framework} {version}: the models changed without a migration
migration_finding: The models and the migrations disagree ({framework}): add the missing migration. {detail}
perf_setting_harness: The harness of the instance {tool} is {value}; use one of: {allowed}.
perf_setting_budgets: The budgets of the instance {tool} must map each benchmark name (or * pattern) to a positive number of milliseconds.
perf_setting_baseline: The baseline of the instance {tool} must be a relative path inside the component, without '..'.
perf_setting_regression: The maxRegressionPercent of the instance {tool} is {value}; use a number of 0 or more.
perf_baseline_missing: The baseline file {file} does not exist. Copy the baseline-candidate.json of a run you trust there, or remove the baseline setting.
perf_baseline_invalid: The baseline file {file} is not a JSON object of benchmark names and mean times in milliseconds.
perf_needs_budgets: The instance {tool} has neither budgets nor a baseline file: there is nothing to compare the benchmarks with. Set budgets (benchmark -> maximum mean in ms) or baseline.
perf_no_harness: The component {dir} has no benchmark harness JGates can run (pytest-benchmark, vitest bench, go test -bench, criterion, BenchmarkDotNet). Set harness on the instance.
perf_missing: {harness} is not available to the check ({detail}). Declare it in the component's dependencies.
perf_condition_machine: Runs the project's benchmarks (project code) in the step container: the times depend on its CPU limit and on the machine.
perf_condition_budgets: {count, plural, one {# budget} other {# budgets}} of mean time per benchmark.
perf_condition_baseline: Compared with the baseline {file}; a benchmark more than {percent}% slower is a regression.
perf_limitation: The benchmarks execute (project code): the result is self-reported and never cached; times need a margin.
perf_failed: {harness} ended with code {code}: a benchmark or the build failed, so nothing was measured. {detail}
perf_no_benchmarks: {harness} ran no benchmark: nothing was measured.
perf_finding_budget: The benchmark {name} took {mean} ms on average, over its budget of {limit} ms ({rule}).
perf_finding_regression: The benchmark {name} took {mean} ms on average, more than {percent}% over its baseline of {baseline} ms ({file}).
perf_finding_unmatched: No benchmark that ran matches the budget {rule}: the budget was not verified.
perf_reason: {harness} {version}: {count, plural, one {# benchmark} other {# benchmarks}} measured, {breaches, plural, one {# breach} other {# breaches}} of the budgets and the baseline
vuln_missing: The .NET SDK is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup).
vuln_limitation: Needs the network to the package sources for their vulnerability data, and the component restored by the deps phase.
vuln_condition_network: Asks the package sources (nuget.org) for their vulnerability data: the step has the network.
vuln_error: dotnet list package --vulnerable did not give a usable report (code {code}): {detail}
vuln_finding_transitive: {package} {version}, a transitive dependency, has a known vulnerability ({severity}): {advisory} ({framework})
vuln_reason: dotnet {version}: {projects, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} checked against {sources}, {count, plural, one {# vulnerable package} other {# vulnerable packages}}
migration_needs_url: The instance {tool} has no databaseUrl: set the URL of the services database the framework connects to (handed over in {variable}).
migration_setting_sql: The sql setting of the instance {tool} must be a list of relative *.sql paths or patterns inside the component, without commas or '..'.
migration_reason_sql: squawk {version}: {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} in the SQL migrations, {blocking} blocking
form_migration_framework_help: Which framework compares the models with the migrations. Without it, JGates detects it from the component.
form_migration_databaseUrl_help: The URL of the database of the project's compose services, with the test credentials of the compose file. JGates cannot guess it.
form_migration_databaseUrlEnv_help: The environment variable the project's configuration reads the URL from (DATABASE_URL by default).
form_migration_prismaSchema_help: The schema file, relative to the component (prisma/schema.prisma by default).
form_migration_dotnetProject_help: The .csproj with the EF Core migrations, relative to the component.
form_migration_sql_help: The SQL migration files squawk lints, relative paths or patterns (migrations/**/*.sql by default).
form_perf_harness_help: Which harness runs the benchmarks. Without it, JGates detects it from the component. The budgets themselves (benchmark -> milliseconds) are written in tools.yml.
form_perf_baseline_help: A JSON file of the component with the mean times of a run you trust (copy the baseline-candidate.json of a run there).
form_perf_maxRegressionPercent_help: How much slower than the baseline a benchmark may be before it is a finding.
form_e2e_e2eRunner_help: Which runner executes the e2e tests. Without it, JGates detects it from the component.
form_e2e_target_help: service:<name>:<port> for a service of the project's compose, or an http or https URL. Without it, the services target of jgates.yml is used.
